_comment: Out-of-tree layers that modify the Hermes runtime but are NOT Hermes plugins (so they are not in plugins.json / not installed via 'hermes plugins enable'). Each entry: id, title, repo, branch, install (how to install), survives_update_via (mechanism), doctor_check (what doctor.sh verifies), related_config (template path), tracked_by_prs. CI lint validates this file too.

patches.title: Claude Code OAuth billing bypass
patches.install: clone rarf/hermes-claude-auth && ./install.sh (installs patches/anthropic_billing_bypass.py + venv sitecustomize.py loader)
survives_update_via: git hooks via core.hooksPath outside repo (post-merge/post-checkout restore venv sitecustomize.py)
patches.doctor_check: patches/sitecustomize.py exists AND venv/Lib/site-packages/sitecustomize.py present AND hermes startup logs '[anthropic_billing_bypass] Bypass installed'
